draws.answer: Schema describes the expected form of the data, including its file format, structure, and organization. It specifies the data types and hierarchy, and indicates how the data is connected to other data through shared keys or relationships. Schema on write requires a schema metastore for relational databases, while schema on read dynamically creates a schema when data is written, using file formats like Parquet or JSON for better performance.

Time series is a series of values organized by time. For example, stock prices might move as trades are executed throughout the day, or a weather sensor will take atmospheric temperatures every minute. Any events that are recorded over time—either regularly or sporadically—are time-series data. A time-series database is optimized for retrieving and statistical processing of time-series data.

Batch processing is about ingesting data in large chunks, typically on a predetermined time interval or as data reaches a preset size threshold. Batch ingestion is a one-way door: once data is broken into batches, the latency for downstream consumers is inherently constrained. Batch processing remains an extremely popular way to ingest data for downstream consumption, particularly in analytics and ML. [Ch. 2]

Column-oriented serialization organizes data by column, storing each column into its own set of files. This allows reading only a subset of fields for analytics applications, reducing the amount of data scanned for queries. Columnar databases pack similar values next to each other, enabling efficient encoding and compression, especially when columns contain many repeated values.

draws.asked_as: What is benefits of data meshs?
draws.answer:
The benefits of data mesh include decentralized, peer-to-peer data serving by domain teams, where each team is responsible for preparing data for consumption and potentially running dashboards and analytics for self-service. This changes the details and structure of serving by introducing new aspects like good data for use in various applications and federated computational governance.
Asked as: "What is benefits of data meshs?"
